_meta.description: Every question about Pano Owl: how many photos it stitches, real 360° output, capture, video, quality, devices, price and availability.
as-many-as-you.87a61d: As many as you like. Pano Owl matches features across the whole set, and its out-of-core tiled engine keeps memory bounded — so the output resolution isn't capped by your device. From a two-shot sweep to a full 360° gigapixel scene.
can-i-turn-a.0f6ea7: Can I turn a video into a panorama?
does-it-keep-the.34976f: Does it keep the quality of my originals?
either-rotational-pivoting-on.ee603b: Either rotational (pivoting on a tripod or in your hand) or a flat scan across a subject. The guided capture mode tracks your motion and auto-captures each frame with the right overlap, and flags blurry shots so you can re-take them.
everything-people-ask-about.f08bcd: Everything people ask about Pano Owl, from how many photos it can stitch to what it costs.
how-many-photos-can.f52fc3: How many photos can I stitch?
iphone-and-ipad-on.c22143: iPhone and iPad, on iOS and iPadOS 26 or later. Guided capture, stitching, correcting and the 360 viewer all run on the device itself.
is-pano-owl-available.48236b: Is Pano Owl available in the European Union?
pano-owl-is-a.9e0eee: Pano Owl is a one-time purchase on the App Store. There's no subscription, no ads and no in-app purchase.
the-pipeline-works-in.21fc4f: The pipeline works in high bit depth and warps at full resolution, so you keep the detail of your source photos rather than downscaling to fit memory. You can also straighten, drag-to-correct distortion, and adjust the crop before exporting.
what-devices-does-it.b7b7b0: What devices does it run on?
what-kind-of-capture.56eab8: What kind of capture works best?
yes-pano-owl-is.29e000: Yes. Pano Owl is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
yes-pick-a-video.3efcb6: Yes. Pick a video and Pano Owl extracts the cleanest, well-spaced frames automatically, then stitches them like any other set.
yes-true-equirectangular-spherical.b0a5b: Yes — true equirectangular (spherical) output, plus cylindrical and planar. Partial arcs and full 360 both work. Exports include standard GPano metadata, so they render correctly in web viewers, the Photos app, and on Apple Vision Pro.
